The repositories do not include the user-supplied ROM or generated game assets.

fields.summary: Windows x64 static recompilation of the PS2 NTSC-U SCUS-97399 executable to C++ using PS2Recomp. Since October 2026, this repository has based its native hardware runtime on Waffle565’s God of War Native Port while maintaining its own God of War function map, recompilation configuration, patches, overrides, scripts and status checks. It does not include game files or generated code; build requires the user’s own legal copy.

fields.status: Experimental research compatibility layer; the official compatibility overview was last updated 2026-10-12. The current generated tracker lists 84 titles by highest measured milestone: 14 reached a reviewed automatic gameplay snapshot guard, 1 a PS5 hardware comparison, 3 manual visual verification, 12 gameplay with a rendered scene, 23 title screen, 11 any real graphics, and 20 not started. These are title-specific routed milestones, not a claim that those games are fully playable. The latest listed release remains v0.2.4 (2026-10-10).
fields.summary: Experimental user-space PS5-to-PC compatibility layer for Linux and Windows, with macOS x86-64 documented for the Darwin substrate only. PS5 x86-64 game code runs directly on the host CPU; the project loads/links SELF and ELF modules, reimplements selected PS5 system libraries and ABI details, and translates AGC/PM4 graphics plus RDNA2 shaders to Vulkan 1.4/SPIR-V. It is explicitly not a product or general-purpose game runner. Its source describes specific user-supplied dump routes and milestones, which do not establish full-game completion.
fields.platform: PlayStation 5 x86-64 → Linux and Windows 10/11 x86-64; macOS x86-64 exercises the Darwin substrate only. AGC/RDNA2 graphics → Vulkan 1.4/SPIR-V.

fields.platform: Metal AIR/LLVM IR shaders and a documented subset of Metal-shaped API programs → SPIR-V and Vulkan pipelines; the published runtime requires a Vulkan 1.2 device. Building the Rust libraries requires Rust 1.98 or newer.
fields.status: Alpha; the current repository manifests declare version 0.2.0, while the README says that version is not on crates.io and the crates.io 0.1.0 listing is an unrelated earlier design. The latest GitHub release tag remains v0.1.0 (2026-07-22). The README describes typed refusals for unsupported inputs and states that APIs and outputs can change during the 0.x series.
fields.summary: A Rust workspace with a Metal AIR/LLVM IR-to-SPIR-V translator and a separate Metal-shaped runtime over Vulkan. The current README documents compute, render, tessellation, tile, and mesh stages and a Vulkan 1.2 device requirement; unsupported or not-yet-covered inputs fail with a refusal instead of claiming an equivalent pipeline. The authored validation suite compares selected cases against Metal, while the private corpus is not included in the public repository, so the project does not imply complete Metal compatibility.
